using System.Collections;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using UnityEngine;
using UnityEngine.Networking;

// Generated by the Warboard v35 structural refactor.
// Method bodies were moved verbatim from GameController.cs.
public partial class GameController : MonoBehaviour
{
    private bool SelectedUnitCanCharge()
    {
        if (selectedSquad == null ||
            !selectedSquad.IsAlive ||
            selectedSquad.FactionId !=
                activeFaction)
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool canChargeAfterFallBack =
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules.CanChargeAfterFallBack(
                selectedSquad
            );

        bool canChargeAfterAdvance =
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules.CanChargeAfterAdvance(
                selectedSquad
            );

        if (selectedSquad.HasCharged ||
            (selectedSquad.HasFallenBack &&
             !canChargeAfterFallBack) ||
            (selectedSquad.HasAdvanced &&
             !canChargeAfterAdvance) ||
            (missionSystem != null &&
             missionSystem.UnitHasStartedAction(
                 selectedSquad)) ||
            IsEngaged(selectedSquad))
        {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void TryCharge(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target)
    {
        if (!Core11AircraftChargeAllowed(attacker, target))
            return;

        if (attacker != null && core11CannotChargeThisTurn.Contains(attacker.JoinedActionController()))
        {
            status = attacker.DisplayName + " cannot declare a charge this turn.";
            return;
        }


        if (missionSystem != null &&
            missionSystem.UnitHasStartedAction(
                attacker))
        {
            status =
                "That unit started a mission action this turn and cannot declare a charge.";
            return;
        }

        if (showStratagemReaction)
        {
            status =
                "Resolve the current reaction window first.";
            return;
        }

        if (attacker.HasCharged)
        {
            status =
                "That squad already attempted a charge.";
            return;
        }

        if (attacker.HasFallenBack &&
            !(aeldariRules != null &&
              aeldariRules.CanChargeAfterFallBack(
                  attacker
              )))
        {
            status =
                "That squad Fell Back this turn and cannot charge.";
            return;
        }

        if (attacker.HasAdvanced &&
            !(aeldariRules != null &&
              aeldariRules.CanChargeAfterAdvance(
                  attacker
              )))
        {
            status =
                "That squad Advanced this turn and cannot declare a charge.";
            return;
        }

        if (IsEngaged(attacker))
        {
            status =
                "That squad is already engaged.";
            return;
        }

        NotifyChargeDeclared(

            attacker,

            target);


        attacker.HasCharged = true;

        if (!IsXcomMode)
        {
            traditionalChargePending = true;
            traditionalChargeAttacker =
                attacker;
            traditionalChargeTarget =
                target;
            traditionalChargeResult = 2;

            OpenTraditionalDicePrompt(
                2
            );

            AppendBattleLog(
                "CHARGE",
                attacker.DisplayName +
                " → " +
                target.DisplayName,
                "Charge declared. Player resolves 2D6 and any tabletop rerolls manually, then enters the final total."
            );

            status =
                "TRADITIONAL CHARGE: roll 2D6 manually, handle any rerolls yourself, then enter the final charge total.";

            return;
        }

        int roll =
            RollChargeDice();

        BeginChargeRollDecision(
            attacker,
            target,
            roll
        );
    }

    private int RollChargeDice()
    {
        return
            DiceRoller.Roll2D6(
                "Charge"
            );
    }

    private void BeginChargeRollDecision(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        int roll)
    {
        GameEventContext context =
            new GameEventContext
            {
                Type =
                    GameEventType.ChargeRolled,
                Game = this,
                ActingFaction =
                    activeFaction,
                Phase = phase,
                Source = attacker,
                Target = target,
                RollTotal = roll,
                PreviousRollTotal = 0,
                IsReroll = false
            };

        GameEventBus.Raise(context);

        IStratagem commandReroll =
            StratagemRegistry.Get(
                "command_reroll"
            );

        if (attacker
            .JoinedActionController()
            .IsBattleShocked)
        {
            ResolveChargeRoll(
                attacker,
                target,
                roll,
                false,
                0
            );

            return;
        }

        if (commandReroll != null &&
            commandReroll.CanUse(
                this,
                activeFaction,
                context))
        {
            pendingChargeAttacker =
                attacker;

            pendingChargeTarget =
                target;

            pendingChargeRoll =
                roll;

            pendingOriginalChargeRoll =
                roll;

            pendingReactionContext =
                context;

            showStratagemReaction = true;

            status =
                attacker.DisplayName +
                " rolled " +
                roll +
                " to charge " +
                target.DisplayName +
                ". Keep the roll or spend 1 CP on Command Re-roll.";

            return;
        }

        ResolveChargeRoll(
            attacker,
            target,
            roll,
            false,
            0
        );
    }

    private void KeepPendingChargeRoll()
    {
        if (!showStratagemReaction ||
            pendingChargeAttacker == null ||
            pendingChargeTarget == null)
        {
            CloseStratagemReaction();
            return;
        }

        SquadController attacker =
            pendingChargeAttacker;

        SquadController target =
            pendingChargeTarget;

        int roll =
            pendingChargeRoll;

        CloseStratagemReaction();

        ResolveChargeRoll(
            attacker,
            target,
            roll,
            false,
            0
        );
    }

    private void UseCommandRerollOnPendingCharge()
    {
        if (!showStratagemReaction ||
            pendingReactionContext == null ||
            pendingChargeAttacker == null ||
            pendingChargeTarget == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        IStratagem commandReroll =
            StratagemRegistry.Get(
                "command_reroll"
            );

        if (commandReroll == null ||
            !commandReroll.Use(
                this,
                activeFaction,
                pendingReactionContext))
        {
            status =
                "Command Re-roll is not available.";
            return;
        }

        SquadController attacker =
            pendingChargeAttacker;

        SquadController target =
            pendingChargeTarget;

        int previous =
            pendingOriginalChargeRoll;

        int reroll =
            RollChargeDice();

        GameEventBus.Raise(
            new GameEventContext
            {
                Type =
                    GameEventType.ChargeRolled,
                Game = this,
                ActingFaction =
                    activeFaction,
                Phase = phase,
                Source = attacker,
                Target = target,
                RollTotal = reroll,
                PreviousRollTotal =
                    previous,
                IsReroll = true,
                Note =
                    "Command Re-roll"
            }
        );

        CloseStratagemReaction();

        ResolveChargeRoll(
            attacker,
            target,
            reroll,
            true,
            previous
        );
    }

    private void ResolveChargeRoll(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        int roll,
        bool wasRerolled,
        int previousRoll)
    {
        // v41 / 21.03 Take to the Skies reduces the maximum
        // distance of this Charge move by 2 inches.
        if (attacker != null &&
            CoreRules11FlightRegistry.IsTakingToSkies(attacker))
        {
            roll = Mathf.Max(0, roll - 2);
        }

        if (attacker == null ||
            target == null ||
            !attacker.IsAlive ||
            !target.IsAlive)
        {
            status =
                "Charge could not be resolved because a unit is no longer available.";
            return;
        }

        float targetDistance =
            JoinedDistance(
                attacker,
                target
            );

        string rollText =
            wasRerolled
            ? "Command Re-roll " +
              previousRoll +
              " → " +
              roll
            : "rolled " +
              roll;

        if (targetDistance >
            roll + 0.001f)
        {
            status =
                attacker.DisplayName +
                " " +
                rollText +
                ". " +
                target.DisplayName +
                " is " +
                targetDistance.ToString("0.0") +
                " away, so the charge fails.";
            return;
        }

        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original =
            CaptureJoinedPositions(
                attacker
            );

        AutoMoveSquadToward(
            attacker,
            target,
            roll,
            0.90f
        );

        RefineChargePlacementToCurrentRules(
            attacker,
            target,
            roll,
            original
        );

        bool successfulEnd =
            ChargeEndStateIsLegal(
                attacker,
                target,
                roll,
                original
            );

        if (!successfulEnd)
        {
            RestoreJoinedPositions(
                original
            );

            Vector3 legalDelta;

            if (TryFindFormationChargeTranslation(
                attacker,
                target,
                roll,
                out legalDelta))
            {
                TranslateJoinedModels(
                    attacker,
                    legalDelta
                );

                RefineChargePlacementToCurrentRules(
                    attacker,
                    target,
                    roll,
                    original
                );

                successfulEnd =
                    ChargeEndStateIsLegal(
                        attacker,
                        target,
                        roll,
                        original
                    );
            }
        }

        if (!successfulEnd)
        {
            RestoreJoinedPositions(
                original
            );

            status =
                attacker.DisplayName +
                " " +
                rollText +
                ", but the charge solver could not find a legal route/formation into " +
                target.DisplayName +
                ". No models move.";

            return;
        }

        attacker.HasMoved = true;
        attacker.HasCharged = true;
        attacker.MarkMadeChargeMove();

        if (attacker.AttachedLeader != null)
        {
            attacker.AttachedLeader.HasMoved = true;
            attacker.AttachedLeader.HasCharged = true;
        }

        status =
            attacker.DisplayName +
            " " +
            rollText +
            " and charged " +
            target.DisplayName +
            ". Each charger was placed using the current Charge Move priorities: closer; within 1 if possible; engaged if possible.";
    }

    private bool ChargeEndStateIsLegal(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        float chargeDistance,
        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original)
    {
        if (attacker == null ||
            target == null ||
            original == null)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (JoinedDistance(
                attacker,
                target
            ) >
            EngagementRange + 0.05f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!attacker.IsCoherent() ||
            !AllModelsInsideBoard(attacker) ||
            !AllModelsHaveLegalPlacement(attacker) ||
            IsEngagedWithNonTargetEnemy(
                attacker,
                target
            ))
        {
            return false;
        }

        foreach (ModelToken model
            in JoinedModels(attacker))
        {
            Vector3 start;

            if (!original.TryGetValue(
                    model,
                    out start))
            {
                return false;
            }

            Vector3 end =
                model.transform.position;

            if (HorizontalDistance(
                    start,
                    end
                ) >
                chargeDistance + 0.01f)
            {
                return false;
            }

            float before =
                DistancePointToSquad(
                    start,
                    target
                );

            float after =
                DistancePointToSquad(
                    end,
                    target
                );

            // 11e Charge Move: every model must finish closer to one or more
            // selected charge targets.
            if (after >=
                before - 0.001f)
            {
                return false;
            }

            // If this model can legally finish within 1" of a charge target,
            // it must do so.
            if (after >
                    1.0f + 0.05f &&
                ChargingModelCanReachDistance(
                    attacker,
                    model,
                    target,
                    start,
                    chargeDistance,
                    1.0f))
            {
                return false;
            }

            // Otherwise, if it can legally finish engaged with a charge
            // target, it must do so.
            if (after >
                    EngagementRange + 0.05f &&
                ChargingModelCanReachDistance(
                    attacker,
                    model,
                    target,
                    start,
                    chargeDistance,
                    EngagementRange))
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private void RefineChargePlacementToCurrentRules(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        float chargeDistance,
        Dictionary<ModelToken, Vector3> original)
    {
        if (attacker == null ||
            target == null ||
            original == null)
        {
            return;
        }

        // Several passes are useful because moving one charger into an open
        // slot can expose a different legal slot to another model.
        for (int pass = 0;
             pass < 4;
             pass++)
        {
            bool changed = false;

            List<ModelToken> chargers =
                JoinedModels(attacker)
                    .OrderBy(
                        model =>
                            DistancePointToSquad(
                                model.transform.position,
                                target
                            )
                    )
                    .ToList();

            foreach (ModelToken model
                in chargers)
            {
                Vector3 start;

                if (!original.TryGetValue(
                        model,
                        out start))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector3 candidate;

                if (!TryFindBestChargeDestination(
                        attacker,
                        model,
                        target,
                        start,
                        chargeDistance,
                        out candidate))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (HorizontalDistance(
                        candidate,
                        model.transform.position
                    ) <= 0.01f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                Vector3 current =
                    model.transform.position;

                model.transform.position =
                    candidate;

                Physics.SyncTransforms();

                bool wholeUnitLegal =
                    attacker.IsCoherent() &&
                    AllModelsInsideBoard(
                        attacker
                    ) &&
                    AllModelsHaveLegalPlacement(
                        attacker
                    ) &&
                    !IsEngagedWithNonTargetEnemy(
                        attacker,
                        target
                    );

                if (!wholeUnitLegal)
                {
                    model.transform.position =
                        current;

                    Physics.SyncTransforms();
                    continue;
                }

                changed = true;
            }

            if (!changed)
                break;
        }

        attacker.RefreshVisuals();

        if (attacker.AttachedLeader != null)
            attacker.AttachedLeader.RefreshVisuals();
    }

    private bool TryFindBestChargeDestination(
        SquadController attacker,
        ModelToken movingModel,
        SquadController target,
        Vector3 originalStart,
        float chargeDistance,
        out Vector3 result)
    {
        result =
            movingModel.transform.position;

        float startingDistance =
            DistancePointToSquad(
                originalStart,
                target
            );

        Vector3 current =
            movingModel.transform.position;

        float currentDistance =
            DistancePointToSquad(
                current,
                target
            );

        List<Vector3> candidates =
            BuildChargeDestinationCandidates(
                movingModel,
                target,
                originalStart,
                chargeDistance
            );

        bool found = false;

        int bestTier =
            ChargeDistanceTier(
                currentDistance
            );

        float bestTargetDistance =
            currentDistance;

        float bestTravel =
            HorizontalDistance(
                originalStart,
                current
            );

        foreach (Vector3 candidate
            in candidates)
        {
            if (!ChargeDestinationIsLocallyLegal(
                    attacker,
                    movingModel,
                    target,
                    originalStart,
                    candidate,
                    chargeDistance,
                    startingDistance))
            {
                continue;
            }

            Vector3 previous =
                movingModel.transform.position;

            movingModel.transform.position =
                candidate;

            Physics.SyncTransforms();

            bool coherent =
                attacker.IsCoherent();

            movingModel.transform.position =
                previous;

            Physics.SyncTransforms();

            if (!coherent)
                continue;

            float targetDistance =
                DistancePointToSquad(
                    candidate,
                    target
                );

            int tier =
                ChargeDistanceTier(
                    targetDistance
                );

            float travel =
                HorizontalDistance(
                    originalStart,
                    candidate
                );

            bool better =
                tier < bestTier ||
                (tier == bestTier &&
                 targetDistance <
                    bestTargetDistance - 0.01f) ||
                (tier == bestTier &&
                 Mathf.Abs(
                    targetDistance -
                    bestTargetDistance
                 ) <= 0.01f &&
                 travel < bestTravel);

            if (!better)
                continue;

            found = true;
            bestTier = tier;
            bestTargetDistance =
                targetDistance;
            bestTravel = travel;
            result = candidate;
        }

        return found;
    }

    private List<Vector3> BuildChargeDestinationCandidates(
        ModelToken movingModel,
        SquadController target,
        Vector3 originalStart,
        float chargeDistance)
    {
        List<Vector3> candidates =
            new List<Vector3>();

        // Current position is included so the refinement pass only moves a
        // model when it can genuinely improve its rule-priority tier.
        candidates.Add(
            movingModel.transform.position
        );

        foreach (ModelToken enemy
            in JoinedModels(target)
                .OrderBy(
                    model =>
                        HorizontalDistance(
                            originalStart,
                            model.transform.position
                        )
                ))
        {
            float contactDistance =
                MinimumModelSeparation(
                    movingModel,
                    enemy
                );

            float[] desiredRadii =
            {
                contactDistance +
                    0.03f,
                Mathf.Max(
                    contactDistance +
                        0.05f,
                    0.90f
                ),
                Mathf.Max(
                    contactDistance +
                        0.05f,
                    1.00f
                ),
                Mathf.Max(
                    contactDistance +
                        0.05f,
                    1.35f
                ),
                Mathf.Max(
                    contactDistance +
                        0.05f,
                    1.70f
                ),
                Mathf.Max(
                    contactDistance +
                        0.05f,
                    EngagementRange -
                        0.03f
                )
            };

            Vector3 fromEnemy =
                originalStart -
                enemy.transform.position;

            fromEnemy.y = 0f;

            if (fromEnemy.sqrMagnitude <=
                0.0001f)
            {
                fromEnemy =
                    Vector3.back;
            }

            fromEnemy.Normalize();

            for (int angle = -165;
                 angle <= 180;
                 angle += 15)
            {
                Vector3 direction =
                    Quaternion.Euler(
                        0f,
                        angle,
                        0f
                    ) *
                    fromEnemy;

                foreach (float radius
                    in desiredRadii)
                {
                    Vector3 candidate =
                        enemy.transform.position +
                        direction *
                        Mathf.Max(
                            radius,
                            contactDistance +
                                0.02f
                        );

                    candidate.y =
                        originalStart.y;

                    if (HorizontalDistance(
                            originalStart,
                            candidate
                        ) <=
                        chargeDistance + 0.01f)
                    {
                        candidates.Add(
                            candidate
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // Also sample the actual route toward the target. This allows models
        // that cannot engage to still use their legal charge distance and end
        // closer while maintaining coherency.
        ModelToken nearest =
            ClosestJoinedModelTo(
                target,
                originalStart
            );

        if (nearest != null)
        {
            Vector3 delta =
                nearest.transform.position -
                originalStart;

            delta.y = 0f;

            if (delta.sqrMagnitude >
                0.0001f)
            {
                Vector3 direction =
                    delta.normalized;

                for (float travel = 0.20f;
                     travel <=
                        chargeDistance + 0.001f;
                     travel += 0.20f)
                {
                    Vector3 candidate =
                        originalStart +
                        direction *
                        Mathf.Min(
                            travel,
                            chargeDistance
                        );

                    candidate.y =
                        originalStart.y;

                    candidates.Add(
                        candidate
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return candidates;
    }

    private bool ChargeDestinationIsLocallyLegal(
        SquadController attacker,
        ModelToken movingModel,
        SquadController target,
        Vector3 originalStart,
        Vector3 destination,
        float chargeDistance,
        float startingDistance)
    {
        if (!InsideBoard(
                destination))
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (HorizontalDistance(
                originalStart,
                destination
            ) >
            chargeDistance + 0.01f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        float endingDistance =
            DistancePointToSquad(
                destination,
                target
            );

        if (endingDistance >=
            startingDistance - 0.001f)
        {
            return false;
        }

        if (!CanPlaceModel(
                movingModel,
                destination))
        {
            return false;
        }

        bool canPassEnemies =
            aeldariRules != null &&
            aeldariRules
                .CanMoveThroughEnemyModelsWhenCharging(
                    attacker
                );

        if (!CombatMovePathIsClear(
                movingModel,
                originalStart,
                destination,
                canPassEnemies))
        {
            return false;
        }

        // A Charge Move cannot finish engaged with an enemy unit that was not
        // selected as a charge target.
        foreach (SquadController other
            in squads)
        {
            if (other == null ||
                other == target ||
                other.IsAttachedLeader ||
                other.FactionId ==
                    attacker.FactionId ||
                !other.IsAlive ||
                !other.IsOnBattlefield)
            {
                continue;
            }

            if (DistancePointToSquad(
                    destination,
                    other
                ) <=
                EngagementRange + 0.05f)
            {
                return false;
            }
        }

        return true;
    }

    private int ChargeDistanceTier(
        float targetDistance)
    {
        if (targetDistance <=
            1.0f + 0.05f)
        {
            return 0;
        }

        if (targetDistance <=
            EngagementRange + 0.05f)
        {
            return 1;
        }

        return 2;
    }

    private bool TryFindFormationChargeTranslation(
        SquadController attacker,
        SquadController target,
        float roll,
        out Vector3 result)
    {
        result = Vector3.zero;

        Vector3 attackerCentre =
            attacker.CurrentCentre();

        Vector3 targetCentre =
            target.CurrentCentre();

        Vector3 baseDirection =
            targetCentre -
            attackerCentre;

        baseDirection.y = 0f;

        if (baseDirection.sqrMagnitude <=
            0.0001f)
        {
            baseDirection =
                attacker.DirectionToward(
                    target
                );
        }

        baseDirection.Normalize();

        // Search straight ahead first, then progressively wider arcs.
        float[] angleOffsets =
        {
            0f,
            5f, -5f,
            10f, -10f,
            15f, -15f,
            20f, -20f,
            25f, -25f,
            30f, -30f,
            40f, -40f,
            50f, -50f,
            60f, -60f,
            75f, -75f,
            90f, -90f
        };

        // Small increments are intentional. A rigid formation can have a very
        // narrow legal "just engaged but not overlapping" position.
        const float distanceStep = 0.20f;

        Vector3 bestDelta =
            Vector3.zero;

        float bestTravel =
            float.MaxValue;

        foreach (float angle
            in angleOffsets)
        {
            Vector3 direction =
                Quaternion.Euler(
                    0f,
                    angle,
                    0f
                ) *
                baseDirection;

            for (float travel =
                    distanceStep;
                 travel <=
                    roll + 0.001f;
                 travel +=
                    distanceStep)
            {
                Vector3 delta =
                    direction *
                    Mathf.Min(
                        travel,
                        roll
                    );

                if (!FormationTranslationCandidateIsLegal(
                    attacker,
                    target,
                    delta))
                {
                    continue;
                }

                float finalDistance =
                    DistanceSquadToTargetAfterTranslation(
                        attacker,
                        target,
                        delta
                    );

                if (finalDistance >
                    EngagementRange + 0.05f)
                {
                    continue;
                }

                if (travel <
                    bestTravel)
                {
                    bestTravel =
                        travel;

                    bestDelta =
                        delta;
                }

                // For this angle, later samples only move farther than needed.
                break;
            }
        }

        if (bestTravel ==
            float.MaxValue)
        {
            return false;
        }

        result =
            bestDelta;

        return true;
    }

}
